extension.summary: View your Immich photos and videos in Kodi
extension.description: Browse the timeline, On this day, people and pets, places, albums and favourites of a self-hosted Immich server, or search by description. Watch them as a slideshow that crossfades and slowly pans and zooms across each photo, with photo details at the press of Info. View only: nothing is changed on the server. Menu tiles and photo backgrounds need Pillow in Kodi's Python; without it the plain photos are shown.
extension.disclaimer: Requires an Immich server that you own or have an account on. Not affiliated with the Immich project.
extension.news: v0.3.15 - Albums and people show one of their photos whole as the background, like the other folders. A person's is one they're alone in where possible v0.3.14 - Photos play and list oldest first, so a trip runs from start to finish. Photo order in the settings turns it back - The months of a year go January to December; On this day keeps the latest year first v0.3.13 - 0.3.12 said playing a video could no longer freeze Kodi for a minute. Sorry, that was wrong: the freeze is a Kodi 22 bug, fixed upstream in xbmc/xbmc#29548 - The slideshow reads the screen size once, so it can no longer hold up another add-on the same way v0.3.12 - Playing a video can no longer freeze Kodi for a minute v0.3.11 - Needs Kodi 22; a fanart for the add-on; debug lines only in Kodi's debug log v0.3.10 - A thinner outline behind the slideshow caption, date and clock - Kodi quits promptly even with a photo on its way through the proxy v0.3.9 - Folder backgrounds show the whole photo, on a blurred copy of itself, instead of a crop v0.3.8 - Years and months in Timeline, and countries in Places, show one of their photos v0.3.7 - Tile names are drawn properly with the Estuary skin's font v0.3.6 - Favourites that showed a tile go back to the Immich icon by themselves, keeping their place v0.3.5 - Tiles stay on the menu: Immich favourites no longer get one, so pick a thumbnail again for any that did - Kodi quits promptly even with a photo or tile request under way
